# Dagger Digital

> Dagger Digital is a web design agency in Gravesend, Kent, building modern websites, branding and social media content for small businesses across the UK. Every project gets a fixed quote before work starts.

## Services
- [Web design in Gravesend](https://daggerdigital.co.uk/web-design-gravesend.html): Starter website from £600 (up to 3 sections), Business website from £900 (up to 5 pages), Premium website from £1,200. Most small business sites take one to three weeks.
- [Social media management](https://daggerdigital.co.uk/social-media-management.html): Starter Social £200/month (4 posts), Growth Social £350/month (8 posts, 2 platforms), Pro Social £500/month (12 posts, short-form edits).
- [Website care plans](https://daggerdigital.co.uk/website-care-plans.html): hosting, backups and updates. Essential £35/month, Growth £75/month, Premium £150/month.
- Branding and graphics: logo design, business cards and flyers, social media graphics.

## Work
- [En Saver case study](https://daggerdigital.co.uk/en-saver-case-study.html): five-page website for an energy and business consultancy in Romford.

## Working with us
- Based in Gravesend, Kent. Works remotely with businesses throughout the UK.
- A 50% deposit is normally required before work begins, with the balance due before launch.
- Free website audit and a free 15-minute call for new enquiries.
